upstream_hard_gates.summary: Blank canvas creates a Thing without substrate or build concepts.
Timeline is optional; non-Timeline interaction remains valid.
Beginner Rule and advanced Behaviour use the same Behaviour IR.
Connections use stable ports rather than hierarchy paths.
Group to reusable Definition preserves the first concrete Thing identities.
Play/Stop keeps authored and runtime state separate.
Save/reload excludes selection, presence and play/session context.
Publish/load uses an immutable creation revision in a generic player without per-creation build/export.
Simple and advanced Together controls project the same network declaration and exclude transport identity.
People presence/conflicts remain separate from Together runtime multiplayer.
Ordinary failures use author-facing vocabulary rather than substrate/toolchain language.
Protected media keeps stable AssetId plus one indivisible complete immutable revision bundle.

browser_gates.action: Create Button and Lamp Things from a blank canvas.
browser_gates.expect: Stable ThingIds exist and visible author UI needs no engine/build vocabulary.

browser_gates.action: Create interactive Behaviour without Timeline.
browser_gates.expect: Project validates and plays with zero Timeline tracks.

browser_gates.action: Add a Timeline motion by ThingId/property.
browser_gates.expect: Timeline is an optional projection over the same Thing.

browser_gates.action: Compile Rule and Advanced Behaviour projections.
browser_gates.expect: Both produce the same versioned constrained IR shape.

browser_gates.action: Connect Button activated port to Lamp toggle port.
browser_gates.expect: Connection targets stable ThingId + PortId endpoints.

browser_gates.action: Inject hierarchy path as a port.
browser_gates.expect: Validation rejects it before use.

browser_gates.action: Group two Things and Make reusable.
browser_gates.expect: Definition/Element provenance is added while concrete first-instance ThingIds remain unchanged.

browser_gates.action: Play, interact, then Stop.
browser_gates.expect: Runtime state changes; editable authored state does not.

browser_gates.action: Add People presence/conflict, Save, hard reload.
browser_gates.expect: Presence/play context disappears; durable conflict alternatives and canonical authored records survive.

browser_gates.action: Publish and launch separately deployed generic player.
browser_gates.expect: Exact immutable CreationRevisionId loads without author-facing compile/export.

browser_gates.action: Reload exact player while browser networking is disabled.
browser_gates.expect: Service-worker/CacheStorage closure loads the exact same CreationRevisionId or fails typed; no substitution.

browser_gates.action: Choose Shared Together preset and inspect advanced fields.
browser_gates.expect: One spawn/control/authority/replication/relevance declaration is edited.

browser_gates.action: Show collaborator and competing edit in People.
browser_gates.expect: Presence/conflict state does not alter runtime multiplayer declaration.

browser_gates.action: Inspect visible author surface and common failure text.
browser_gates.expect: No Godot/SceneTree/NodePath/ResourceUID/RPC/package-manager/export/build-toolchain concepts are required.

browser_gates.action: Force browser editable-storage denial.
browser_gates.expect: Typed author-language save failure; canonical meaning unchanged.

browser_gates.action: Force unsupported required feature and required capability denial.
browser_gates.expect: Generic player fails before activation with author-language diagnostics.

browser_gates.action: Load identical revision in two peer-hosted player pages and send non-authority input intent.
browser_gates.expect: Both converge on shared Thing state while transient connection identity remains runtime context.

browser_gates.action: Attempt incomplete protected-media replacement.
browser_gates.expect: Replacement is rejected atomically and old complete revision remains unchanged.

browser_gates.action: Publish protected fixture asset and load player.
browser_gates.expect: AssetId and complete digest/source/media/provenance/licence/derivation revision are byte-for-byte equal at publication boundary.

browser_gates.action: Inject host/transport identity or tamper immutable publication.
browser_gates.expect: Validation rejects private runtime identity and digest/revision mismatch before activation.

repairs.finding: An early private-runtime identity filter treated every field named connection_id as transport state and would therefore reject canonical SplashMX ConnectionId records.
repairs.repair: The canonical boundary now forbids explicit transport/session handles such as transport_peer_id and connection_handle while preserving semantic connection_id/ConnectionId.
